newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Zaitun debuts at 6.55 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Zaitun debuts at 6.55 ringgit.

text.p: Malaysian toiletries and cosmetics maker Zaitun Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday at 6.55 ringgit against an offer price of 2.10 ringgit.
The company had offered four million new shares to the public.
The company also offered 4.3 million existing shares for sale at the same price.
Zaitun recorded a turnover of 39 million ringgit for the year to December 31, 1996, and registered a net profit of 4.8 million ringgit.
The compay forecast its net profit to decrease slightly to 4.3 million ringgit in 1997.
